Pursuant to State and County Directives, San Gabriel City Hall is closed to the public and physical access
to the meeting has been suspended. To provide members of the public access to the meeting and an
opportunity to comment on items on and off the Agenda, the following opportunities have been
established:

Public Comments

Please email all public comments on this agenda only to cityclerk@sgch.org and include the following on
the subject line of your email: PUBLIC COMMENT: 12/15/20 Special Meeting. The Clerk will read public
comments into the record for up to the three-minute limit. Words that would disrupt the meeting,
including profanity, obscenity, and discriminatory language, will not be read.

Watch the Meeting Online

MINUTES OF DECEMBER 15, 2020
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Menchaca called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at
  5:31 P.M. on Tuesday, December 15, 2020, with all Council Members and staff
  participating by teleconference.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Tony Ding, John R. Harrington, Jason Pu, Vice Mayor
  Chin Ho Liao, and Mayor Denise Menchaca.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, Assistant City Attorney
  Lloyd Pilchen, Assistant City Manager/Community
  Development Director Armine Chaparyan, Human
  Resources/Risk Management Director Edward Macias,
  Economic  Development  Manager  Domenica
  Megerdichian, and Chief City Clerk Sharon Clark.

I  1. PUBLIC COMMENT - None.

  2. CLOSED SESSION

  Assistant City Attorney Pilchen explained that a matter had come to the City's attention
  subsequent to the posting of the agenda and needed immediate action due to
  legislation which takes effect January 1, 2021.

  A motion was made by Vice Mayor Liao, seconded by Council Member Pu, to add a
  Closed Session item entitled: CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING
  LITIGATION (GOVERNMENT CODE §54956.9) Final Public Employment Relations Board
  (PERB) Decision: 2751-M (San Gabriel Fire Fighters Association v. City of San Gabriel)
  PERB Case No. LA-CE-1297-M [AALRR-Cerritos.006280.00006]

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  DING, HARRINGTON, PU, LIAO, MENCHACA
